Magellan

Sail as far as you can in a dead straight line.

  1. Aim. Drag on the globe to point your boat. Fine-tune with the compass tape or the ±0.1° buttons. The globe stays centred on you, so your course is a straight line until it goes round the back.
  2. Sail. One go per spot. Your boat follows the curve of the Earth, dead straight, until it hits land. Every island counts, so check the close-up circle.
  3. Score. Up to 5,000 points a spot. The closer you get to the longest voyage possible from there, the more you score.

Tip: a straight line on a globe looks curved on a flat map. Trust the globe, not the map in your head.

  • Daily voyage: 10 spots, the same for everyone and the same rules. A new one every midnight, ranked worldwide.
  • Head to head: a duel. Both start with 20,000 HP; each round the shorter voyage loses the difference in km. Once one sailor locks in, the other has 15 seconds.
  • Challenge a friend: send a link and duel live.
  • Practice: random spots, with as much help as you like.

To rank you against other players, the game keeps an anonymous ID for this device, when you start a daily voyage and your daily scores. No emails or accounts. Friend duels also store the name you type.
